stages.prompt: Revise only the Nitely workflow, flow template, prompt, evidence, approval, or orchestration artifact requested by the supplied PR review feedback. Keep the change scoped to workflow behavior, update tests/docs for changed workflow semantics, and produce a concise one-line pr-title artifact that names the workflow rework.

stages.command: git diff --check && pnpm exec vitest run test/flow/load.test.ts test/pr-comments/loop.test.ts && pnpm run check && pnpm run build

stages.prompt: Review the workflow rework against the triggering review feedback. Check flow validity, artifact contracts, approval behavior, evidence quality, CLI compatibility, and whether tests cover the workflow change. Do not modify files during review. Write `Review verdict: pass` when there are no P0/P1/blocking findings. Write `Review verdict: fail` when any P0/P1/blocking issue exists, and list P0/P1 findings first.

Reflect on this workflow rework after the change request has been updated. Review the source feedback, workflow artifacts, verification output, review output, and change request result. Search existing GitHub issues before creating follow-ups. Create GitHub issues only for actionable non-duplicate improvements. Write a concise reflection artifact listing created issue URLs, duplicates found, non-actions/observations, or a clean result when no actionable improvement remains.
